title: Rate limiting and load shedding
description: Learn about Rate limiting and load shedding. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Rate limiting and load shedding** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with rate limiting and load shedding.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of rate limiting and load shedding
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding rate limiting and load shedding is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with rate limiting and load shedding, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
